outcome: Windows machines converge without user-typed setup: forge doctor --fix installs Git and Python through winget in user scope with at most the installer's own OS prompt (never a harness-built elevation, 0040), forge.cmd probes py/python/python3 and can bootstrap Python once via trusted winget before failing closed, init/adopt/upgrade leave repos hook-healthy with named red rows and manual URLs when user-scope cannot converge, and PATH refresh uses API-derived known folders so poisoned environments cannot hijack the flow.
